# Captain Saul

## Overview

- **Age:** 76 years old during the final volume of events  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v4 c7 P14](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0014), [v4 c7 P42](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0042), [v4 c9 P16](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c6 P9](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0009), [v4 c6 P21](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c39 P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v4 c7 P14](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0014), [v4 c9 P35](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0035)</sub>
- **Role:** Lighthouse keeper at Seven Gulls Point, former sea captain  <sub>[v4 c9 P35](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0035), [v4 c14 P1](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Captain Saul; Captain Garrick  <sub>[v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Captain Saul is a tall, broad-shouldered man with a slightly stooped posture, a bronzed and heavily furrowed face, and a thick mane of iron-gray hair reaching his shoulders. He has remarkably blue, deep-set eyes that twinkle, dream, or gaze wistfully at the sea. His hands are muscular and weathered, showing the physical strain of his age in his later years.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c6 P15](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0015), [v4 c7 P1](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0001), [v4 c9 P40](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0040), [v4 c35 P35](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0035)_

## Personality

Possessing a gentle, humble, and deeply empathetic nature, Captain Saul is known for his warmth and boundless hospitality. He is a natural storyteller who delights in sharing sea tales, yet he remains remarkably modest and unpretentious about his past heroics. Unfailingly patient and even-tempered, he approaches life's hardships with calm resilience and unyielding faith. He harbours an intense love for beauty and nature, as well as a protective, tender affection for children and animals.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P9](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0009), [v4 c6 P23](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0023), [v4 c6 P25](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0025), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c7 P11](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0011), [v4 c7 P25](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0025), [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 c9 P40](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0040), [v4 c9 P49](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0049)_

## Goals

- To keep the memory of his lost love, Margaret, alive  <sub>[v4 c20 P15](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0015)</sub>
- To preserve his life-book and sea memoirs for posterity  <sub>[v4 c17 P20](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0020), [v4 c25 P3](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0003)</sub>
- To reunite with Margaret in the afterlife  <sub>[v4 c7 P55](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0055), [v4 c20 P17](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0017), [v4 c35 P34](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0034)</sub>

## History

Captain Saul spent his youth on St. Brendan's Island, forming a deep friendship with the local schoolmaster, John Tremayne. As a young man, he lost his betrothed, Margaret, when she was swept out to sea during a storm, a tragedy that led him to remain unmarried for the rest of his life. He spent over fifty years sailing the globe as a merchant captain, surviving mutinies, shipwrecks, and tiger encounters, while recording his adventures in a personal logbook. During his voyages, he located the missing, amnesiac Laurence Vane in Cuba and brought him back to his home at Seven Gulls. Upon retiring from the sea, he became the keeper of the Seven Gulls Point lighthouse, residing there with his rescued cat, the First Mate. He formed a cherished bond with Nell Harcourt and Hugh Carrow when they settled in the nearby 'house of dreams,' regularly visiting them to offer wisdom, companionship, and storytelling. Before his death, he entrusted his personal memoirs to author Adrian Treleaven, who adapted his adventures into a acclaimed book, fulfilling Captain Saul's lifelong dream. He passed away peacefully in his sleep at the lighthouse, holding his published memoirs to his chest.

_Sources: [v4 c7 P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005), [v4 c7 P28](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0028), [v4 c9 P28](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0028), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c11 P34](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0034), [v4 c14 P1](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0001), [v4 c17 P20](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0020), [v4 c25 P3](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0003), [v4 c39 P4](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0004), [v4 c39 P24](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0024), [v4 c39 P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028)_

## Background by volume

- Ran away to sea as a young man against his father's wishes  <sub>[v4 c7 P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005), [v4 c7 P28](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0028)</sub>
- Lost his youthful sweetheart, Margaret, when her boat drifted out to sea in a storm  <sub>[v4 c20 P16](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0016)</sub>
- Spent fifty years as a sea captain traveling the world before retiring to Seven Gulls Light  <sub>[v4 c7 P28](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0028), [v4 c9 P35](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0035), [v4 c14 P1](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0001)</sub>
- Discovered the long-lost, brain-damaged Laurence Vane in Havana and brought him home  <sub>[v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c11 P34](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0034)</sub>
